7661.title: Cookie lifetime at the desktop persistence boundary
7661.rootCauseOneLine: The real import path emits session cookies without expiry into a persistent partition; Electron documents non-retention across sessions, but runtime restart checks were blocked before seed.
7661.proposedFix: First execute the provided two-process regression on a working Electron host, then decide and design scoped secure retention and deletion semantics if confirmed.
7661.caveats: Both clean checkouts pass the import boundary diagnostic and 36 existing tests. Both Electron launches stop on missing libglib-2.0.so.0. No live restart loss, affected-site sign-out, Chrome comparison, or simple fix is claimed.
